title: Python AlgoChat.encryption_public_key returns raw bytes
no_spec_change_rationale: Python-only return-type fix; the protocol spec, vectors and wire bytes do not change.
acceptance_criteria: KEY-2 and KEY-1.a in hi/key.md (existing intent): AlgoChat.encryption_public_key returns the raw 32-byte X25519 public key, as its annotation and docstring say, so a Python caller can publish it and it matches what other implementations derive from the same account.
